name: Learning, Equity, and Problem Solving for the Public Good (BA)

requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: LEAPS requires a minimum of 120 credits plus demonstrated mastery of the four program-wide learning areas (Ways of Knowing, Personal Good, Group Good, Public Good); the mastery transcript is assessed by the program and is not auto-checked.

requirements.label: Core sequence (EDUC 100, 107, 108, 130, 202, 203)
requirements.hint: Learning Within and Across Settings, Preparing for Engaged Learning I and II, The City as Identity, Design as Community Inquiry, and Inquiry, Partnership, and Research.

requirements.label: LEAPS general education (EDUC 131, 140, 251, 331)
requirements.hint: Science in the City, Writing With Detroit, Mathematics and Society, and Strategic Communication.

requirements.label: Forum (5 credits)
requirements.hint: EDUC 101 (Lower Division Forum, three 1-credit terms) and EDUC 322 (Upper Division Forum, two 1-credit terms). Each completed term counts; a planned term registers once, so log each term as taken when it finishes.

requirements.label: Lower division internship (EDUC 207, 4 credits)
requirements.hint: Community-Engaged Learning Internship; 4 credits required, up to 8 may count.

requirements.label: Concentration (24 credits)
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule: concentrations are chosen junior year from Public-service Entrepreneurship, Education, Public Health, Public Service/Government, or Law, or custom-designed with faculty approval, so no fixed course list exists. Count your concentration courses in with the adjust control.

requirements.label: Capstone (EDUC 481 & 482)
requirements.hint: Education for Empowerment Capstone I and II across senior year. Planning EDUC 481 auto-places EDUC 482 the following term.
